sources.title: Enabling and Configuring the Configuration Cache
sources.finding: The org.gradle.configuration-cache=false system property can disable configuration caching for a specific build even when globally enabled.

sources.title: Build Environment Configuration
sources.finding: GRADLE_OPTS supplies JVM arguments to Gradle; org.gradle.configuration-cache is the configuration-cache setting.
